entities.name: Rohingya
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: A Muslim minority in Buddhist-majority Myanmar denied citizenship since 1982. In 2017, military operations killed thousands and drove 700,000+ to Bangladesh in what the UN called "textbook ethnic cleansing."
